title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Miguel in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Miguel in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1518_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The territory bounded on the North by the provincial road from the Municipality of Bauan to the Municipality of Mabini, on the East by a river called Ilog ng Tubigan, on the West by the Sta. Maria River, and on the South by the sea, is separated from the barrios of San Andres and Bolo, Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas, and constituted into a barrio of the said municipality to be known as the barrio of San Miguel.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
